basic_info.description: Lovingly owned by the same family for many decades, this two bedroom, one bath gem offers timeless character and the unbeatable convenience of San Francisco's Parkside neighborhood.   Situated on a spacious fenced lot, this home is ideal for those seeking both charm and opportunity. Inside, you'll find vintage architectural details that convey craftsmanship and history. Graceful curved ceilings in the living and dining rooms, original glass doorknobs, period lighting, wood trim, baseboards and hardwood floors. A separate dining room with a bay window and vintage art deco chandelier invites cozy meals and gatherings. On the street level, along with the garage, you'll find a storage room, a utility/ laundry room and backyard access.   CityStructure, Inc has provided analysis for development possibilities which are available in the disclosure packet.  Enjoy Pine Lake Park, Stern Grove, shopping, dining, and transit. This home offers a place to retreat while still enjoying the perks of urban living.
